facts.claim: Ramp offers a financial operations platform covering corporate cards, expenses, bill payments, procurement, vendor management, travel, banking, and accounting automation.
facts.excerpt: More than 70,000 businesses use Ramp to manage corporate cards, expenses, bill payments, procurement, vendor management, travel, banking, and accounting automation in one system.

facts.claim: Ramp says its customers have saved more than $12 billion and 27.5 million hours, and save 5% or more on average.
facts.excerpt: Ramp customers have saved more than $12 billion and 27.5 million hours by using Ramp's controls, automation, and savings insights.

facts.claim: Ramp supports more than $100 billion in annualized card and accounts-payable payment volume.
facts.excerpt: Ramp supports more than $100 billion in annualized card and AP payment volume

facts.claim: In June 2026, Ramp announced a $750 million financing round at a $44 billion valuation to invest further in AI advancements for customers.
facts.excerpt: Raises $750 Million to invest further in AI advancements for customers
facts.source_title: Ramp Raises Series F at $44 Billion Valuation

facts.claim: Ramp reported releasing more than 70 products and major features in recent months, acquiring Billhop and Juno, and planning to serve UK- and Europe-headquartered companies in summer 2026.
facts.excerpt: In the past few months, Ramp released 70+ products and major features, closed two acquisitions — Billhop (UK/EU payments) and Juno (guest travel) — and announced it would start serving companies headquartered in the UK and Europe this summer.
facts.source_title: Ramp Raises Series F at $44 Billion Valuation

facts.claim: Ramp announced a multi-year partnership with Stanford Athletics, becoming its official expense management partner.
facts.excerpt: Stanford Athletics and Ramp today announced a multi-year partnership naming Ramp the official expense management partner of Stanford Athletics.
facts.source_title: Stanford Athletics Selects Ramp to Modernize Financial Operations in Multi-Year Partnership - Stanford Cardinal - Official Athletics Website

facts.claim: Ramp announced a deeper multi-year Visa partnership to enable AI agents to make autonomous corporate payments with real-time controls.
facts.excerpt: Ramp also deepened its multi-year partnership with Visa to enable AI agents to execute autonomous corporate payments with real-time controls.
facts.source_title: Ramp Raises Series F at $44 Billion Valuation

research.website_note: Ramp’s official website identifies Ramp Business Corporation and presents Ramp’s financial products and services.
research.gaps: The results do not specify Ramp’s current hiring priorities or detailed pricing.

strategy.observation: Ramp reported releasing more than 70 products and major features in recent months.
strategy.offer_link: An expense-policy template could serve as a practical content resource alongside coverage of Ramp’s expense-management workflows, translating product interest into guidance finance teams can use.
hypotheses: Ramp’s content team may be looking for reusable practical resources to support its product coverage.
Mid-size finance teams may be a relevant audience for Ramp’s content.
strategy.angle: With more than 70 products and major features released in recent months, an expense-policy template could give Ramp’s finance readers a practical companion to its expense-management content.
strategy.fit_reason: The offer is relevant to Ramp’s expense-management subject matter and could be useful as content, but the facts do not establish that Ramp targets mid-size teams or that its Head of Content is seeking template-based resources.

draft.subject: Expense policy resource

Ramp has released more than 70 products and major features in recent months. If your expense-management coverage is prompting finance teams to revisit their policies, a practical template could give readers something useful to take away.
